task: Build the Helios endpoint that receives inbound payment-provider webhooks.

rubric.criterion: Verifies the webhook using the per-endpoint HMAC secret and rejects invalid signatures or timestamp skew over ~5 minutes.
Acknowledges with HTTP 200 immediately and processes the event asynchronously (via a queue) rather than processing inline / blocking the response.
Treats downstream billing writes idempotently (e.g. via an Idempotency-Key).
No raw PII or secret values are written to logs.
